Success-path behavior is unchanged. Static finding; no additional runtime claim.

Workspace redirect retains302 and path, but baseline global redirect wrapper directive set differs from current noCache policy. Current still has no-store; this is a directive difference rather than a missing cache boundary.

Successful index response message adds word record. OID/details and status/envelope/queue behavior retained.
